name: toolchain-cache-policy
description: Enforces one shared, bounded build/cache location per toolchain across all worktrees and clones, so N parallel agent worktrees cannot each grow a multi-GB build tree and fill the disk. A SessionStart hook (1) writes shared cache env for cargo, sccache, uv, pip, go, npm, pnpm, bun, and gradle to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, (2) enforces the cargo config target-dir (config files apply unconditionally), and (3) runs a disk-pressure GC that evicts regenerable build output (cargo target, go build cache) when free space drops below a floor, never touching module/package download stores. Fails open; advisory only. Claude SessionStart; Codex SessionStart parity.
